name: resolve_region
description: Resolve a human-readable region name such as Fiji, Tonga, Melanesia, or a specific island into a spatial region artifact with GeoJSON geometry.

region_name.description: The user-facing region name to resolve, such as 'Fiji', 'Tonga', 'Vanuatu', 'Melanesia', 'PNG', or 'Pacific Islands'.

admin_level.description: Optional administrative level to disambiguate the region. Examples: country, island, province, district, city, subregion, region_group.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].
